हैंडसम हंक Brad Pitt को भी कभी किसी ने डेट पर अकेला छोड़ा था, क्या आप इस बात पर यकीन कर सकते हैं? 😲

बात 1989 की है जब MTV Video Music Awards में एक्ट्रेस Christina Applegate ने Brad Pitt को अपना डेट बनाकर बुलाया था। उस वक्त Brad Pitt स्ट्रगलिंग एक्टर थे और दोनों सिर्फ अच्छे दोस्त थे।

लेकिन इवेंट के दौरान Christina की नज़र Skid Row बैंड के लीड सिंगर Sebastian Bach पर पड़ी। क्रिस्टीना के मुताबिक वे रॉकस्टार की तरफ इतनी आकर्षित हुईं कि अवार्ड शो खत्म होते ही वे Brad Pitt को छोड़कर उनके साथ चली गईं! 😱

क्रिस्टीना के जाने के बाद Brad Pitt को उनकी मां और दोस्त को गाड़ी से घर छोड़ना पड़ा। रिपोर्ट्स के मुताबिक, इस घटना से Brad Pitt इतने दुखी और चिढ़ गए थे कि वे कई सालों तक उनसे नाराज रहे।

क्रिस्टीना ने अपनी किताब You With The Sad Eyes में इसका खुलासा करते हुए लिखा कि उस रात वे खुद को बेहद पावरफुल महसूस कर रही थीं। 📖

अगर आपके साथ डेट पर ऐसा कोई करता, तो आपका क्या रिएक्शन होता? कमेंट्स में जरूर बताएं! 👇

ctx.title: Christina Applegate Once Ditched Brad Pitt The Worst Way Possible For A Rockstar
ctx.summary:
Christina Applegate once went on a date with Brad Pitt before ditching him for a famous rockstar. Here's the awkward story behind it. 
 The post  Christina Applegate Once Ditched Brad Pitt The Worst Way Possible For A Rockstar  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
Brad Pitt has been winning over women’s hearts for decades now. But even the Hollywood Heartthrob wasn’t everyone’s first choice; at least not Christina Applegate’s. Back in 1989, Applegate made it pretty clear when she left Pitt stranded at an awards show and went after a rock star.
Back then, Brad Pitt was not the popular Hollywood A-lister and was still trying to find his footing in the industry. But Applegate was already enjoying considerable television success.
For years, Applegate kept the identity of the mystery man under wraps, only to spill it all in her memoir, You With The Sad Eyes.
Back in 1989, Christina Applegate was in her early teens and establishing herself in the television industry through Married… With Children. However, Brad Pitt was still an aspiring actor at the time. Being longtime “platonic pals,” she naturally invited Pitt as her date to the MTV Video Music Awards.
But as soon as she reached the venue in a Cecil Chapman gown, someone else caught her eye. Well, that someone was none other than Sebastian Bach, the lead singer of the rock band Skid Row.
According to Applegate, she had been watching Bach throughout the evening and found herself drawn to him. Eventually, she decided to leave with the musician instead.
“In fact, I felt so powerful and sure of myself for once that when the awards show was over, I left with Sebastian Bach, not Brad Pitt,” she wrote.
While Christina Applegate left the ceremony with Sebastian Bach, Brad Pitt found himself in a rather uncomfortable situation.
The actress had brought her mother and a friend to the event, and after she walked out with the rock star, Pitt was the one who had to take them home.
Applegate recalled that he “was left to sullenly drive” them back. Understandably, he wasn’t particularly pleased with how the evening had turned out. And his frustration didn’t disappear the next morning. In fact, Pitt spent many years being mad at Applegate.
